_comment: C0-15 sglang bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」2 行带 .md 链接（vllm/langgraph），related 写 2 条（frontmatter related 是 [openai-agents-sdk, langgraph]，键按正文链接行对齐=2）。sources 3 条对齐 frontmatter。runs 引用 models 站 guides 快照口径，照源短译。

axes.model_access: safetensors/HF-line weights are the mainstay; the supported-model list follows the official docs, not inventoried item by item. The official positioning covers "large language models and multimodal models" (repo description, direct-fetched).
axes.runtime: A serving inference framework: RadixAttention prefix-cache reuse is the official signature (the self-reported figures were verified as a snapshot in the models-site guides serving-deep-dive.md, same source); GitHub 37,571★ (API verified 2026-10-21).
axes.local_files: Self-hosted deployment, data in your own environment; no official managed cloud line seen — third-party cloud hosting does not count as official.
axes.background: The product form is a resident service (an OpenAI-compatible server); prefix reuse in agent multi-turn scenarios is the narrative focus.
axes.tools: The OpenAI-compatible API includes tool calling; structured output (the official language-features line) is in the docs; MCP not verified item by item.
axes.context: RadixAttention's reuse of context across multi-turn/shared prefixes is the main axis; details not verified item by item.
axes.permissions: Self-hosted with no account system; API authentication configured by the deploying party; multi-tenancy/isolation surfaces not verified item by item.
axes.fit: Fits: serving scenarios with agent multi-turn calls/shared system prompts (prefix-reuse gains are direct), wanting structured-output language features. Does not fit: single-machine out-of-the-box quantized tiers; wanting the widest ecosystem-compatibility surface (vLLM's ecosystem is broader).

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The models-site guides `serving-deep-dive.md` has already verified SGLang's official framing (RadixAttention self-reported figures); this dossier reuses the same snapshot source. No runner-specific test protocol exists on this site yet.
unknowns:
- The full supported-model list (not inventoried item by item)
- MCP support status (not verified item by item)
- The current stability of the structured-output language (SGLang's official DSL) (not verified item by item)
related: The other pole of serving inference: vLLM's ecosystem is broader, SGLang's prefix-reuse narrative is sharper.
Cross-category contrast: multi-turn calls in agent orchestration frameworks are the typical beneficiary workload of SGLang's prefix reuse.
